## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Asymmetric KV cache quantization preserves key vector outlier dimensions in FP8 or FP16 while quantizing value vectors to 4-bit affine blocks, reducing KV memory by up to 70% with less than 0.1 perplexity delta. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-examples/tree/main/llms · keywords: Local Inference Micro-Architectures: Signaling, Quantization Superblocks, and Kernel Pipeline Scheduling · also: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
- [statement] Synchronously blocking CPU execution on MTLCommandBuffer waitUntilCompleted() prevents overlapping CPU dispatch with GPU execution, causing up to 25% throughput degradation on small models. - [statement] When speculative verification achieves an acceptance rate greater than 60%, end-to-end token generation throughput increases by 25% to 45% on memory-bandwidth-constrained devices. ## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Speculative decoding amortizes parameter weight memory loading across K candidate tokens by evaluating candidate sequences as a small parallel GEMM batch instead of K sequential GEMV reads. (high confidence) — https://huggingface.co/Qwen · keywords: Local Inference Micro-Architectures: Signaling, Quantization Superblocks, and Kernel Pipeline Scheduling · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp
